summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 new features: loading veil, hero social strip + activated contact cards, and editable link URLs. Also regression of WYSIWYG text edit, country-block tab, and pay-detail contentEditable. All 10 test scenarios PASS after resolving a testing nuance around admin panel close.

test_results.T1_loading_veil: PASS — #veil with .veil-panel.left/.right and .veil-mark present on fresh load; removed from DOM in ~3s (waited detached, succeeded).
test_results.T2_hero_social_strip: PASS — [data-testid=hero-social-strip] visible with 4 pills: hero-onlyfans-btn → https://onlyfans.com/candiceferragamo, hero-telegram-btn → https://t.me/candiceferragamo, hero-whatsapp-btn → https://wa.me/message/46V4TW2E5ASNF1, hero-snapchat-btn → https://snapchat.com/t/OkSSAxsc. All have target=_blank.
test_results.T3_contact_cards: PASS — contact-onlyfans-btn and contact-telegram-btn present in #contact grid, both show 'Open' status, valid hrefs. Telegram is no longer 'Closed/Not available'.
test_results.T4_backstage_edit_mode: PASS — #backstage hash + password candice2026 login; toggling #editStatus flips body.edit-mode class and small text becomes 'ON'. 20 [data-link] elements get computed outline-style: dashed (from body.edit-mode [data-link] CSS rule).
test_results.T5_editable_link_prompt: PASS — page.on('dialog') captured prompt 'Link URL for this button:', accepting with https://onlyfans.com/newhandle updated hero-onlyfans-btn href to new URL, showed toast 'Link updated', and localStorage 'candice_links' contains {"l17":"https://onlyfans.com/newhandle"}.
test_results.T6_edit_mode_nav_guard: PASS — With edit mode ON, dismissing the prompt kept URL unchanged (preventDefault + stopPropagation on capture-phase handler working correctly). No _blank tab opened.
test_results.T7_persistence_after_reload: PASS — Reloaded page, passed age gate; hero-onlyfans-btn href reapplied to https://onlyfans.com/newhandle from localStorage.candice_links via loadLinks(). Cleaned up localStorage after check.
test_results.T8_wysiwyg_regression: PASS — Editing .hero h1 [data-edit] to 'TestHeadline' then blur produced toast 'Saved' and localStorage.candice_content contains 'TestHeadline'.
test_results.T9_country_tab_regression: PASS — Clicking [data-tab='geo'] activated .admin-section[data-section='geo'] with country list rendered.
test_results.T10_pay_detail_contenteditable: PASS — .pay-detail elements have contenteditable='true' in edit mode.

critical_code_review_comments: UX nuance (not a bug per spec, worth flagging): closeAdmin() auto-disables edit mode when the × button is clicked. This means users cannot close the admin panel while remaining in edit mode. During testing, closing the panel before clicking a [data-link] would silently disable the URL-edit prompt. Consider decoupling 'close panel' from 'exit edit mode', or add a visible on-screen indicator (e.g., persistent 'EDIT MODE ON' badge) so the user knows edit mode auto-turned-off after closing the panel.

handleLinkEditClick at admin.js:205 uses the closure variable `editMode` which is only reflected AFTER toggleEditMode runs. Fine as-is, but during initial diagnosis the fact that clicks pre-toggle showed editMode=false could confuse — self-documenting.

The veil removal uses a hard-coded setTimeout(2600) — if the DOM/anim CSS timing changes, veil-mark might still be visible when removed. Consider tying removal to CSS animationend event for robustness.
admin.js file is 717 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold from code review guidelines. Consider splitting into modules (auth, editing, media, links, geo).
LINK_SELECTORS include '.hero-social .hs-btn' — all pills tagged. tagLinks() assigns sequential data-link ids each load — good for stable persistence across DOM changes.
seed_data_creation: None — localStorage keys candice_links and candice_content were set during tests and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features (loading veil, hero social strip + Telegram/OnlyFans contact cards, editable link hrefs) are working correctly. KEY TESTING GOTCHA: closing the admin panel via the × button turns OFF edit mode (closeAdmin calls toggleEditMode if editMode is true). To test [data-link] URL editing, do NOT click #btnAdminClose after enabling edit mode — instead hide the panel visually (e.g., transform:translateX(120%)) while keeping edit mode on. Backstage login flow: Ctrl+Shift+K OR page.goto(url+'/#backstage'), then fill #adminPassInput and click #btnAdminEnter (submitAdminLogin closes login modal + opens #adminPanel). Toggle edit mode by clicking #editStatus. LINK_SELECTORS = ['.pay-btn','.contact-btn','.hero-social .hs-btn'], keyed by data-link='l1'…'l20'. Prompt fires via window.prompt so page.on('dialog') must be registered before click.
rca_of_the_issue: During initial test iterations the URL-edit prompt never fired even though [data-link] was tagged and body.edit-mode class was present. Instrumenting handleLinkEditClick with a console.log revealed that at the moment the hero-onlyfans-btn was clicked, editMode was actually FALSE. The event log traced back to: clicking #btnAdminClose (to get the panel out of the way for hero click) invokes closeAdmin(), which contains `if(editMode) toggleEditMode();` — auto-disabling edit mode. Mitigation in tests: don't click × after enabling edit; hide panel via style.transform instead. In production this is by-design behaviour but is a subtle UX trap for users.
